# Grace & Kit Carrow

- [Grace](../character/grace.md) — Comrade of — [Kit Carrow](../character/kit-carrow.md) — devoted companions and confederates · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> The Ashdown children sit in the old [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) cemetery talking about gravestones, ghosts, and the [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) family. Drawn by the smell of cooked trout, they run down to [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow) and join the [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) children for supper, quickly becoming fast friends.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P20](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0020), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P37](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045)_

> [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) attends church with the manse children using borrowed clothes, making a scene by sticking her tongue out at a parishioner. Refusing to attend school, she cleans the manse, spars with [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) over food, and spends time with the local children at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow). Despite occasional arguments, Mary captivates the children with her stories, ghost tales, and unique tricks.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P8](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P9](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P31](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0031)_

> [Tessa Carrow](../character/tessa-carrow.md) is tasked with carrying a basket of strawberries to the manse, but [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) harasses and chases her through the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) street with a dried codfish. Miss Winifred rescues the terrified [Tessa](../character/tessa-carrow.md) and returns her home, where Miss Winifred, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) discuss Mary's wild behavior, the local children, and potential wives for the minister.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P16](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER VII. A FISHY EPISODE P19](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0019)_

> Miss Winifred interrogates Mary at the manse and later updates [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) after learning that Mrs. [Grimble](../character/grimble.md) has died. Meanwhile, the children gather at [Fern Hollow](../codex/places.md#fern-hollow), where Edmund reads myths and imagines the Pied Piper leading them away. [Bess](../character/bess-carrow.md) arrives with news of Mrs. Grimble's death, startling Mary, but [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) reassures her and promises to pray that Mary can remain in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES

MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P39](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0039)_

> Mary informs [Grace](../character/grace.md) and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) that they caused a scandal in the community by doing household chores on Sunday after getting their days mixed up. [Grace](../character/grace.md) laughs off the mistake once she realizes how the days were miscounted, reassuring [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) that she has a plan to clarify everything to the town.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P0](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P10](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P23](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P47](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0047)_

> [Mary Stubbs](../character/mary-stubbs.md) scolds the manse children in the graveyard for their misbehavior and the gossip it causes, revealing rumors that their father might marry [Clementine Ainslie](../character/clementine-ainslie.md). After Mary leaves, [Kit Carrow](../character/kit-carrow.md) arrives and suggests they start a [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) to manage their behavior and avoid bringing shame on their father.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P3](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P33](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0033), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P49](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0049), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P54](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0054)_

> At Kit's suggestion, [Grace](../character/grace.md) and her siblings decide to form the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) to self-regulate their behavior and avoid bringing shame on their father. After writing up their agreement and signing it in the cemetery by lantern light, [Grace](../character/grace.md) and [Ida](../character/ida-ashdown.md) go to bed and discuss Mary Stubbs's warnings about stepmothers and the rumor about Miss Ainslie.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P54](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0054), [v5 CHAPTER XXIII. THE GOOD-CONDUCT CLUB P80](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0080)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Miss Winifred discuss the upcoming marriages of [Clementine](../character/clementine-ainslie.md) Ashdown and [Harriet Ainslie](../character/harriet-ainslie.md), as well as plans for the minister's children while he is away. Meanwhile, the local children gather outdoors on Kit's final night before leaving for Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), where Edmund imagines the Pied Piper calling the boys away to follow him.
>
